author: Aad, Georges and others
title: Search for the lepton flavor violating decay Z->e mu in pp collisions at sqrt(s)=8 TeV with the ATLAS detector
abstract: The ATLAS detector is used to search for the lepton flavor violating process Z->e mu in pp collisions using 20.3 fb-1 of data collected at sqrt(s)=8 TeV. There is no evidence of an enhancement at the Z boson mass, resulting in an upper limit on the branching fraction, B(Z->e mu) < 7.5e-7 at the 95% confidence level.
